NKJV.2: “How long will you torment my soul, And break me in pieces with words?
NKJV.3: These ten times you have reproached me; You are not ashamed that you have wronged me.
NKJV.4: And if indeed I have erred, My error remains with me.
NKJV.5: If indeed you exalt yourselves against me, And plead my disgrace against me,
NKJV.6: Know then that God has wronged me, And has surrounded me with His net.
NKJV.7: “If I cry out concerning wrong, I am not heard. If I cry aloud, there is no justice.
NKJV.8: He has fenced up my way, so that I cannot pass; And He has set darkness in my paths.
NKJV.9: He has stripped me of my glory, And taken the crown from my head.
NKJV.10: He breaks me down on every side, And I am gone; My hope He has uprooted like a tree.
NKJV.11: He has also kindled His wrath against me, And He counts me as one of His enemies.
NKJV.12: His troops come together And build up their road against me; They encamp all around my tent.
NKJV.13: “He  has removed my brothers far from me, And my acquaintances are completely estranged from me.
NKJV.14: My relatives have failed, And my close friends have forgotten me.
NKJV.15: Those who dwell in my house, and my maidservants, Count me as a stranger; I am an alien in their sight.
NKJV.16: I call my servant, but he gives no answer; I beg him with my mouth.
NKJV.17: My breath is offensive to my wife, And I am repulsive to the children of my own body.
NKJV.18: Even young children despise me; I arise, and they speak against me.
NKJV.19: All my close friends abhor me, And those whom I love have turned against me.
NKJV.20: My bone clings to my skin and to my flesh, And I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.
NKJV.21: “Have pity on me, have pity on me, O you my friends, For the hand of God has struck me!
NKJV.22: Why do you persecute me as God does, And are not satisfied with my flesh?
NKJV.23: “Oh, that my words were written! Oh, that they were inscribed in a book!
NKJV.24: That they were engraved on a rock With an iron pen and lead, forever!
NKJV.25: For I know that my Redeemer lives, And He shall stand at last on the earth;
NKJV.26: And after my skin is destroyed, this I know, That in my flesh I shall see God,
NKJV.27: Whom I shall see for myself, And my eyes shall behold, and not another. How my heart yearns within me!
NKJV.28: If you should say, ‘How shall we persecute him?’— Since the root of the matter is found in me,
NKJV.29: Be afraid of the sword for yourselves; For wrath brings the punishment of the sword, That you may know there is a judgment.”

NLT.2:
“How long will you torture me?
How long will you try to crush me with your words?
NLT.3:
You have already insulted me ten times.
You should be ashamed of treating me so badly.
NLT.4:
Even if I have sinned,
that is my concern, not yours.
NLT.5:
You think you’re better than I am,
using my humiliation as evidence of my sin.
NLT.6:
But it is God who has wronged me,
capturing me in his net.
NLT.7:
“I cry out, ‘Help!’ but no one answers me.
I protest, but there is no justice.
NLT.8:
God has blocked my way so I cannot move.
He has plunged my path into darkness.
NLT.9:
He has stripped me of my honor
and removed the crown from my head.
NLT.10:
He has demolished me on every side, and I am finished.
He has uprooted my hope like a fallen tree.
NLT.11:
His fury burns against me;
he counts me as an enemy.
NLT.12:
His troops advance.
They build up roads to attack me.
They camp all around my tent.
NLT.13:
“My relatives stay far away,
and my friends have turned against me.
NLT.14:
My family is gone,
and my close friends have forgotten me.
NLT.15:
My servants and maids consider me a stranger.
I am like a foreigner to them.
NLT.16:
When I call my servant, he doesn’t come;
I have to plead with him!
NLT.17:
My breath is repulsive to my wife.
I am rejected by my own family.
NLT.18:
Even young children despise me.
When I stand to speak, they turn their backs on me.
NLT.19:
My close friends detest me.
Those I loved have turned against me.
NLT.20:
I have been reduced to skin and bones
and have escaped death by the skin of my teeth.
NLT.21:
“Have mercy on me, my friends, have mercy,
for the hand of God has struck me.
NLT.22:
Must you also persecute me, like God does?
Haven’t you chewed me up enough?
NLT.23:
“Oh, that my words could be recorded.
Oh, that they could be inscribed on a monument,
NLT.24:
carved with an iron chisel and filled with lead,
engraved forever in the rock.
NLT.25:
“But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives,
and he will stand upon the earth at last.
NLT.26:
And after my body has decayed,
yet in my body I will see God!
NLT.27:
I will see him for myself.
Yes, I will see him with my own eyes.
I am overwhelmed at the thought!
NLT.28:
“How dare you go on persecuting me,
saying, ‘It’s his own fault’?
NLT.29:
You should fear punishment yourselves,
for your attitude deserves punishment.
Then you will know that there is indeed a judgment.”

AMP.2:
"How long will you torment and exasperate me
And crush me with words?
AMP.3:
"These ten times you have insulted me;
You are not ashamed to wrong me [and harden your hearts against me].
AMP.4:
"And if it were true that I have erred,
My error would remain with me [and I would be conscious of it].
AMP.5:
"If indeed you [braggarts] vaunt and magnify yourselves over me
And prove my disgrace (humiliation) to me,
AMP.6:
Know then that God has wronged me and overthrown me
And has closed His net around me.
AMP.7:
"Behold, I cry out, 'Violence!' but I am not heard;
I shout for help, but there is no justice.
AMP.8:
"He has walled up my way so that I cannot pass,
And He has set darkness upon my paths.
AMP.9:
"He has stripped me of my honor
And removed the crown from my head.
AMP.10:
"He breaks me down on every side, and I am gone;
He has uprooted my hope like a tree.
AMP.11:
"He has also kindled His wrath [like a fire] against me
And He considers and counts me as one of His adversaries.
AMP.12:
"His troops come together
And build up their way and siege works against me
And camp around my tent.
AMP.13:
"He has put my brothers far from me,
And my acquaintances are completely estranged from me.
AMP.14:
"My relatives have failed [me],
And my intimate friends have forgotten me.
AMP.15:
"Those who live [temporarily] in my house and my maids consider me a stranger;
I am a foreigner in their sight.
AMP.16:
"I call to my servant, but he does not answer;
I have to implore him with words.
AMP.17:
"My breath is repulsive to my wife,
And I am loathsome to my own brothers.
AMP.18:
"Even young children despise me;
When I get up, they speak against me.
AMP.19:
"All the men of my council hate me;
Those I love have turned against me.
AMP.20:
"My bone clings to my skin and to my flesh,
And I have escaped [death] by the skin of my teeth.
AMP.21:
"Have pity on me! Have pity on me, O you my friends,
For the hand of God has touched me.
AMP.22:
"Why do you persecute me as God does?
Why are you not satisfied with my flesh (anguish)?
AMP.23:
"Oh, that the words I now speak were written!
Oh, that they were recorded in a scroll!
AMP.24:
"That with an iron stylus and [molten] lead
They were engraved in the rock forever!
AMP.25:
"For I know that my Redeemer and Vindicator lives,
And at the last He will take His stand upon the earth.
AMP.26:
"Even after my [mortal] skin is destroyed [by death],
Yet from my [immortal] flesh I will see God,
AMP.27:
Whom I, even I, will see for myself,
And my eyes will see Him and not another!
My heart faints within me.
AMP.28:
"If you say, 'How shall we [continue to] persecute him?'
And 'What pretext for a case against him can we find [since we claim the root of these afflictions is found in him]?'
AMP.29:
"Then beware and be afraid of the sword [of divine vengeance] for yourselves,
For wrathful are the punishments of that sword,
So that you may know there is judgment."

MSG.6:
Tell it to God—he's the one behind all this,
he's the one who dragged me into this mess.
MSG.7:
"Look at me—I shout 'Murder!' and I'm ignored;
I call for help and no one bothers to stop.
MSG.8:
God threw a barricade across my path—I'm stymied;
he turned out all the lights—I'm stuck in the dark.
MSG.9:
He destroyed my reputation,
robbed me of all self-respect.
MSG.10:
He tore me apart piece by piece—I'm ruined!
Then he yanked out hope by the roots.
MSG.11:
He's angry with me—oh, how he's angry!
He treats me like his worst enemy.
MSG.12:
He has launched a major campaign against me,
using every weapon he can think of,
coming at me from all sides at once.
MSG.14:
everyone who knows me avoids me.
My relatives and friends have all left;
houseguests forget I ever existed.
MSG.15:
The servant girls treat me like a bum off the street,
look at me like they've never seen me before.
MSG.16:
I call my attendant and he ignores me,
ignores me even though I plead with him.
MSG.17:
My wife can't stand to be around me anymore.
I'm repulsive to my family.
MSG.18:
Even street urchins despise me;
when I come out, they taunt and jeer.
MSG.19:
Everyone I've ever been close to abhors me;
my dearest loved ones reject me.
MSG.20:
I'm nothing but a bag of bones;
my life hangs by a thread.
MSG.21:
"Oh, friends, dear friends, take pity on me.
God has come down hard on me!
MSG.22:
Do you have to be hard on me too?
Don't you ever tire of abusing me?
MSG.23: "If only my words were written in a book—
MSG.25:
Still, I know that God lives—the One who gives me back my life—
and eventually he'll take his stand on earth.
MSG.26: And I'll see him—even though I get skinned alive!—
MSG.27:
see God myself, with my very own eyes.
Oh, how I long for that day!
MSG.28:
"If you're thinking, 'How can we get through to him,
get him to see that his trouble is all his own fault?'
MSG.29:
Forget it. Start worrying about yourselves.
Worry about your own sins and God's coming judgment,
for judgment is most certainly on the way."
